content: modernc.org/sqlite is a CGo-free database/sql driver registered as sqlite. DSN = plain file path or file: URI plus query params. Per-connection driver keys: _pragma (repeatable; runs PRAGMA <value> on every new connection), _txlock (deferred|immediate|exclusive), and validated shorthand _busy_timeout/_timeout, _journal_mode/_journal, _synchronous/_sync, _auto_vacuum/_vacuum, _foreign_keys/_fk, _query_only. Fixed application order: _busy_timeout and _auto_vacuum first (auto_vacuum must precede first write), then _pragma values, then remaining keys, _query_only last. SQLite URI params (mode, cache) only apply in file: form; a plain path has its query consumed by the driver before sqlite3_open_v2. Driver opens read-write-create with SQLITE_OPEN_FULLMUTEX, supports darwin/linux/windows amd64+arm64, and at v1.60.1 bundles SQLite 3.53.4. Official docs warn every connection carries its own page cache and libc state and recommend bounding the pool with SetMaxOpenConns; connections obtained via sql.Conn.Raw are not concurrency-safe. The package requires importing the exact modernc.org/libc version pinned in its go.mod (v1.77.1 for v1.60.1). StrictPragmas(true) rejects multi-statement _pragma values for DSNs that are not compile-time constants.
